repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供交互式开发者成长路线图，涵盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等数十个技术方向，辅以最佳实践指南与面试题库，帮助开发者系统规划职业路径并提升技能。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers interactive developer roadmaps across dozens of tech domains like frontend, backend, DevOps, AI, and data science, along with best practices and interview questions to guide career growth and skill development.

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
repos.summary_en: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: Java 面试 & 后端通用面试指南，覆盖计算机基础、数据库、分布式、高并发、系统设计与 AI 应用开发
repos.summary_zh: JavaGuide 是 Java 及后端技术面试的权威指南，涵盖 Java 基础、集合、并发、IO、JVM、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计等核心知识。提供系统化面试题解析、源码深度剖析及实战项目（如 AI 智能面试平台），支持在线阅读与 PDF 下载，是后端开发者备战大厂面试的首选资源。
repos.summary_en: JavaGuide is the authoritative guide for Java and backend technical interviews, covering core topics including Java fundamentals, collections, concurrency, I/O, JVM, databases, distributed systems, high-concurrency, and system design. It offers systematic interview question analysis, in-depth source code breakdowns, and practical projects (e.g., AI-powered interview assistant), with online reading and PDF download options. It's the top resource for backend developers preparing for top-tier tech interviews.

repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。
repos.summary_zh: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，提供可运行代码与交互式学习体验，覆盖数学原理、算法实现与工程实践。该书被全球500多所大学采用，支持中英双语教学，强调批判性思维与动手能力，助力学习者成为具备实战能力的AI应用科学家。
repos.summary_en: Dive into Deep Learning is an open-source textbook designed for Chinese readers, offering executable code and interactive learning. It integrates mathematical theory, algorithmic implementation, and engineering practice, adopted by over 500 universities worldwide. The book emphasizes hands-on learning to cultivate AI application scientists with both theoretical depth and practical skills.

repos.description: 人生进阶指南 韩先凯的人生进阶指南 终身学习指南：学习、AI 协作、创业与成长。
repos.summary_zh: 一份融合英语进阶与人生成长的开放指南，提供从词汇、听力到口语、写作的系统训练方法，并深度整合 Gemini、ChatGPT 等 AI 工具构建高效学习闭环。同时包含创业复盘与低谷重生的真实样本，适合寻求长期主义成长路径的学习者。
repos.summary_en: An open guide integrating English mastery with personal growth, offering systematic training from vocabulary to speaking/writing, and deeply incorporating AI tools like Gemini and ChatGPT for efficient learning loops. It also features real-world entrepreneurship reflections and recovery stories for long-term self-improvement.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 人生进阶指南 离谱的人生 离谱的英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语
repos.summary_zh: 《离谱的英语学习指南》是一份系统化的英语进阶学习指南，结合作者自身高分经验与科学方法，涵盖词汇、听力、阅读、口语、写作及AI辅助等模块，强调语言学习的自然性与趣味性，提供从CEFR等级到实用技巧的完整路径，助力学习者高效突破瓶颈。
repos.summary_en: This advanced English learning guide offers a comprehensive, scientifically-informed approach to mastering English through structured modules on vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing, and AI tools. It emphasizes natural language acquisition and personal enjoyment, providing a clear roadmap from CEFR levels to practical strategies for learners aiming to break through plateaus.

repos.description: 高性价比人生指南: 长寿防病、急救、省钱理财、法律红线、失业与工伤、医保社保、恋爱婚育、怀孕育儿、创业与做平台合规、出国与技能。每条写明成本、收益、证据等级和原始出处，只引期刊论文与官方文件。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一份循证生活指南，收录498条高性价比建议，覆盖健康长寿、急救、理财、法律红线、婚育育儿、创业合规等领域。每条建议明确标注成本、收益、证据等级及原始文献出处，仅引用期刊论文与官方文件，并提供在线检索与筛选功能。
repos.summary_en: An evidence-based life guide with 498 high-cost-performance recommendations covering longevity, first aid, finance, legal risks, marriage & parenting, and entrepreneurship compliance. Each entry specifies cost, benefit, evidence grade and original references from peer-reviewed journals and official documents, with online search and filtering support.

repos.description: TensorFlow Tutorial and Examples for Beginners (support TF v1 & v2)
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 TensorFlow 初学者提供全面且结构化的学习路径，涵盖从基础操作到高级模型的完整示例。通过 Jupyter Notebook 和源码结合的方式，清晰展示 TF v1 与 v2 的实现差异，重点突出现代 API 最佳实践（如 layers、estimator、dataset），适合希望快速上手 TensorFlow 并掌握其核心功能的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive, beginner-friendly tutorial for TensorFlow, featuring clear examples in both notebooks and source code for TF v1 and v2. It covers fundamental operations to advanced models, emphasizing modern API practices such as layers, estimator, and dataset. Ideal for developers seeking hands-on experience with TensorFlow's core functionalities.

repos.description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
repos.summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
repos.summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

repos.description: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
repos.summary_zh: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
repos.summary_en: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.description: 💻  vibe coding 101｜The first course for AI-native product builders.
repos.summary_zh: 《Easy-Vibe》是面向初学者的现代编程入门课程，主打“会说话就会做应用”的零门槛理念。通过清晰的学习地图与可视化交互教程，帮助新手系统掌握编程技能，避免学完就忘。支持多语言，涵盖从基础到实战的完整路径。
repos.summary_en: Easy-Vibe is a beginner-friendly modern programming course designed to teach coding from scratch with the motto 'if you can talk, you can build apps.' It features a structured learning map and step-by-step visual tutorials to ensure lasting understanding, supported in multiple languages for global accessibility.

repos.description: ai副业赚钱大集合，教你如何利用ai做一些副业项目，赚取更多额外收益。The Ultimate Guide to Making Money with AI Side Hustles: Learn how to leverage AI for some cool side gigs and rake in some extra cash. Check out the English version for more insights.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为AI副业赚钱指南，系统整理利用AI技术开展副业的多种方法，涵盖内容创作、图片生成、音频处理、直播等方向。通过技术变现思路分享与实操案例，帮助用户在AI时代构建可持续的流量与收益模式，强调做垂类内容、卖工具（铲子）而非直接挖金子的策略。
repos.summary_en: This repository serves as a comprehensive guide to making money with AI side hustles, curating proven methods across content creation, image generation, audio processing, and live streaming. It emphasizes strategic positioning—focusing on niche content and selling tools (shovels) rather than competing in saturated markets—to help users build scalable AI-driven income streams in the current era.

repos.description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
repos.summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

repos.description: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》（李宏毅老师推荐👍，苹果书🍎），PDF下载地址：https://github.com/datawhalechina/leedl-tutorial/releases
repos.summary_zh: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》是台湾大学李宏毅教授经典课程的中文教程，涵盖深度学习核心理论与前沿技术。教程以幽默易懂的方式讲解复杂概念，结合动画案例与详细公式推导，降低学习门槛。内容源自2021年春课程并扩展2017年春课程及外部知识，适合深度学习初学者系统入门。
repos.summary_en: LeeDL-Tutorial is a comprehensive Chinese guide to deep learning based on Professor Hung-yi Lee's renowned courses. It simplifies complex concepts through engaging examples and detailed derivations, covering core theories and techniques. Expanded from the 2021 Spring course with additional content from 2017 and external resources, it serves as an ideal entry point for beginners in deep learning.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: 《Python Cookbook》 3rd Edition Translation
repos.summary_zh: 《Python Cookbook》3rd Edition 中文翻译项目，由David Beazley原著，完整覆盖Python 3.6特性，提供100+实用代码示例，涵盖数据结构、并发编程、网络开发等核心领域，是中文开发者掌握Python 3的权威实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This is the Chinese translation of 'Python Cookbook' 3rd Edition by David Beazley, featuring 100+ practical Python 3.6 code examples across core domains like data structures, concurrency, and network programming, serving as an authoritative hands-on guide for Chinese developers mastering Python 3.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
repos.summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: Google 开源项目风格指南 (中文版)
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Google 开源项目风格指南的权威中文翻译版，涵盖 C++、Python、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Shell、HTML/CSS 等 8 种主流语言的编码规范。内容详尽，提供统一的代码风格指导，提升大型项目协作效率与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This is the authoritative Chinese translation of Google's open-source style guides, covering coding standards for 8 major languages including C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Shell, and HTML/CSS. It provides comprehensive guidelines to ensure consistency, readability, and maintainability in large-scale software projects.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.
repos.summary_zh: Anx Reader 是一款专为书迷打造的智能电子书阅读器，集成强大 AI 功能，支持 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、PDF 等多种格式。提供 AI 摘要、翻译、思维导图生成、多端同步、自定义排版、语音朗读及阅读统计等深度功能，致力于提升阅读效率与沉浸体验。
repos.summary_en: Anx Reader is an AI-powered e-book reader designed for book lovers, supporting multiple formats like EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, TXT, and PDF. It features AI summaries, translation, mind mapping, cross-platform sync, customizable typography, TTS, and reading analytics to enhance focus and reading pleasure.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: Technical guide to making money and investing（最全赚钱投资指南）
repos.summary_zh: 系统整理全球经典投资理财书籍资源，覆盖初阶到高阶16本必读著作，涵盖价值投资理念、资产配置方法与财富思维建设。适合希望通过持续学习实现财务自由的读者，提供可直接获取的优质投教资源。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 16 essential personal finance and investing books from beginner to advanced levels. Covers value investing principles, asset allocation strategies, and wealth-building mindsets. Ideal for learners seeking accessible, high-quality financial education resources on the path to financial freedom.

repos.description: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
repos.summary_zh: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: 中国软件著作权申请材料 生成器 Skills，本 Skills 通过阅读本地项目，自动生成全套 .docx 软著申请材料，全开源，无须再付费购买任何软著申请服务
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个开源的 Codex Skill，用于自动生成中国软件著作权申请全套材料（含申请表、操作手册和代码文档）。它基于本地真实项目源码分析，确保材料真实合规，支持前30页/后30页代码截取规则，输出标准 .docx 和 .txt 文件，全程本地处理，避免依赖付费代办服务。
repos.summary_en: An open-source Codex Skill that auto-generates complete Chinese software copyright application materials (forms, manuals, code docs) from local project source code. It ensures authenticity, follows the 30-page code rule, outputs standardized .docx/.txt files, and runs locally to eliminate paid agency dependencies.

repos.description: Learn python3 in one picture.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过一张图片全面展示 Python3 核心语法与特性，涵盖数据类型、流程控制、函数、类、模块等关键内容，辅以 IPython Notebook 交互版本，适合快速入门与参考。
repos.summary_en: This project presents a comprehensive one-page visual guide to Python 3 syntax and features, including data types, control flow, functions, classes, and modules, with an interactive IPython Notebook version for easy learning and reference.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: 翻译自Miguel Grinberg的blog https://blog.miguelgrinberg.com 的2017年新版The Flask Mega-Tutorial教程
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 Miguel Grinberg 《The Flask Mega-Tutorial》2017年版的完整中文翻译，涵盖从基础到部署的全栈开发实践。通过23章系统讲解 Flask 框架核心功能，包括模板、表单、数据库、用户认证、Ajax、全文搜索、国际化及多平台部署（Linux/Heroku/Docker），适合中高级开发者构建复杂 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains the complete Chinese translation of Miguel Grinberg's 2017 'The Flask Mega-Tutorial', covering full-stack web development with Flask from basics to deployment. Spanning 23 chapters, it systematically teaches core Flask features including templating, forms, databases, authentication, Ajax, full-text search, internationalization, and multi-platform deployment (Linux/Heroku/Docker), ideal for intermediate to advanced developers building complex web applications.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: Elasticsearch权威指南中文版
repos.summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch权威指南》中文版由Looly团队主导翻译，系统解析Elasticsearch核心原理与高级特性，涵盖索引设计、查询优化、集群管理等关键技术点，是深入掌握Elasticsearch的权威学习资料，支持多平台阅读。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide', led by Looly, provides a comprehensive deep-dive into Elasticsearch's core concepts, including indexing, advanced querying, and cluster management. It serves as an authoritative resource for mastering Elasticsearch's advanced features and internal mechanisms.

repos.description: 租房要点，适用于北上广深杭，欢迎补充。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国一线城市（北上广深杭）租房核心要点，聚焦避坑指南与实操策略，涵盖直租识别、中介甄别、合同陷阱防范及合租注意事项，强调实地验房与房东资质核查，旨在帮助租客规避常见纠纷、保障居住安全与权益。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles essential rental tips for major Chinese cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hangzhou), focusing on avoiding pitfalls and practical strategies. It covers identifying direct landlord rentals, vetting agents, contract traps, and co-living safety, emphasizing on-site inspections and landlord qualification checks to protect tenants from disputes and unsafe housing.

repos.description: 如果有人让你推荐 Python 技术书，请让他看这个列表
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 Python 开发者精心整理的权威技术书籍推荐列表，涵盖入门到进阶全阶段，包含《Head First Python》《集体智慧编程》《利用 Python 进行数据分析》等经典著作，结合社区投票与豆瓣评分，提供高质量学习资源导航。
repos.summary_en: This repo curates a comprehensive list of authoritative Python technical books from beginner to advanced levels, featuring classics like 'Head First Python', 'Programming Collective Intelligence', and 'Python for Data Analysis', backed by community votes and Douban ratings for reliable learning guidance.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: elasticsearch 权威指南
repos.summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch 权威指南》中文版项目，由译者 Gavin Foo 翻译自 Clinton Gormley 和 Zachary Tong 的原作，涵盖 Elasticsearch 的核心概念、全文搜索、结构化查询、数据分析、地理定位、自动补全等高级功能，并提供生产环境配置与监控实践，适合开发者与数据工程师系统学习 Elasticsearch。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide' by Gavin Foo, based on the original work by Clinton Gormley and Zachary Tong. This project covers core concepts, full-text search, structured queries, analytics, geolocation, autocomplete, and production deployment of Elasticsearch, serving as a comprehensive resource for developers and data engineers.

repos.description: vue2.0-tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource. It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

repos.description: AndroidCat安卓书签导航集合
repos.summary_zh: AndroidCat 是一个专为 Android 开发者打造的网址导航集合，涵盖资源文档、技术社区、教程、开源项目等八大类别，提供官方文档、设计指南、开发框架、技术资讯等一站式学习资源，助力开发者高效获取 Android 开发所需工具和知识。
repos.summary_en: AndroidCat is a curated collection of Android development resources, serving as a comprehensive navigation hub for developers. It aggregates official documentation, design guidelines, frameworks, tutorials, open-source projects, and tech communities across eight categories, enabling efficient access to essential tools and knowledge for Android development.

repos.description: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
repos.summary_zh: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
repos.summary_en: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: 帮你从文档生成对应的多张配图，内置了歸藏精心探索的图片风格，支持 16:9 和 3:4 两种比例，方便发小红书以及推特。
repos.summary_zh: Document Illustrator 是一款基于 AI 智能分析的文档配图生成工具，能自动理解任意格式文档内容并生成专业配图。支持三种风格（渐变玻璃卡片、票据风格、矢量插画）和两种比例（16:9/3:4），可生成封面图与内容配图，适用于小红书、推特等社交媒体内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Document Illustrator is an AI-powered tool that intelligently analyzes document content to generate professional illustrations. It supports three visual styles (gradient glass, ticket, vector illustration) and two aspect ratios (16:9/3:4), capable of creating cover images and thematic illustrations for social media platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter.

repos.description: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

repos.description: A bilingual teaching guide to Claude Code, organized as a readable   learning path covering architecture, execution flow, tool systems,   and the real writing process behind the guide.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个双语教学指南，旨在从零开始系统学习 Claude Code 源码。通过结构化章节和实际执行流程分析，帮助开发者深入理解其架构设计、工具系统和核心模块。结合 VitePress 构建可导航网站，并提供完整的开发过程记录，适合 AI 编码代理架构研究与自学。
repos.summary_en: This bilingual teaching guide provides a structured learning path to study the Claude Code source code from scratch. It covers architecture, execution flow, tool systems, and real writing processes, enabling readers to build a clear mental model of its design and implementation. Built with VitePress for web navigation and includes full development transcripts.

repos.description: ChatGPT&AIGC资料汇总，包含前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目和商业变现等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为ChatGPT与AIGC领域的综合性资料库，涵盖前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目与商业变现路径，提供注册升级指南及深度行业研报，助力开发者与从业者快速掌握AI技术生态与落地场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates comprehensive resources on ChatGPT and AIGC, including cutting-edge news, application cases, technical tutorials, open-source projects, and monetization strategies. It provides registration/guide tutorials and in-depth industry reports to help developers and professionals quickly master the AI technology ecosystem and real-world applications.

repos.description: 📚《Flutter 入门指南》
repos.summary_zh: 《Flutter 入门指南》是一本系统介绍 Flutter 跨平台开发框架的电子书，涵盖 Dart 语言、Skia 图形引擎及 Material Design UI 开发。适合有 JavaScript 基础的前端开发者快速掌握移动端、Web 和桌面端应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: 《Flutter 入门指南》is a comprehensive guide to Flutter, covering Dart language, Skia graphics engine, and Material Design UI development for cross-platform apps (mobile, web, desktop). Ideal for frontend developers with JavaScript background.

repos.description: python code style guide book / python 代码、单元测试和项目规范
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Python 代码风格、单元测试与项目规范的完整指南，旨在为 Python 项目（尤其是 Web 项目）提供统一的开发标准。涵盖代码风格、测试实践、项目结构等核心内容，支持在线阅读与多种格式下载，采用 CC0 许可，鼓励社区协作完善。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive Python code style guide, unit testing practices, and project standards, particularly for web projects. It covers coding conventions, testing methodologies, and project structure, available for online reading and download in multiple formats. Released under CC0, it encourages community contributions to improve and expand the guide.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.
